Staff engineer, developer tools at Harborline • 1st
2h
Spent the week replacing our bespoke CI runner with a boring off-the-shelf one. Build times dropped 40% and, more importantly, nobody has to page the platform team when a cache key goes stale. The lesson keeps repeating: the clever infrastructure you maintain yourself is rarely worth what it costs to keep alive.
